user_goal: Test whether J-Space/vector control can causally steer multiple model instances directly, iterating until a working mechanism is found without paid provider execution.

execution_classification.note: This is a bounded mechanism experiment on synthetic locally trained hookable Transformer classifiers. It is not an EntityOS runtime acceptance run, not Qwen3-0.6B execution evidence, and not API-instance evidence.

hypothesis: A model can be causally steered by adding a J-Space-derived vector in its residual/latent stream, and a quantized control packet can preserve the steering effect if a model/version/layer-specific basis adapter maps canonical J-Space intent into the model's local latent coordinates.
counterhypotheses: The apparent effect is merely a generic large perturbation rather than direction-specific control.
q8 quantization destroys the useful causal direction.
One raw vector can be injected unchanged across independently initialized model instances.
A naive averaged gradient direction is necessarily a better transferable actuator than a mean-difference direction.

scratch_model.model_class: small locally trained Transformer classifier with direct per-layer residual intervention
scratch_model.task: synthetic categorical YES/NO classification used only to test causal intervention mechanics
scratch_model.important_scope_note: The holdout is disjoint from steering-direction/layer/gain calibration, but the classifier itself was trained on the synthetic task examples; this is a steering-mechanism holdout, not a model-generalization benchmark.

initial_mean_difference_4_instances.interpretation: Direction-specific causal steering is present; unchanged raw coordinates do not transfer reliably between independently initialized latent bases.

q8_holdout_6_instances_fixed_layer.interpretation: q8 precision is not the primary bottleneck; per-model latent basis and intervention location dominate reliability. Raw transfer is occasionally effective by chance/alignment but not robust.

naive_gradient_direction_countertest.interpretation: Naively averaged local gradients are not automatically the best local or shared actuator; gradient provenance alone does not justify promotion.

layer_calibrated_q8_latent_basis_adapter.calibration_rule: For each independent model, evaluate mean-difference directions at candidate intervention stages using the steering calibration split only; choose the stage plus smallest gain that reaches full calibration flip; q8-quantize that selected local steering vector; evaluate only on the disjoint steering holdout.
layer_calibrated_q8_latent_basis_adapter.interpretation: The working mechanism is canonical J-Space/control intent plus a model/version/layer-specific LatentBasisAdapter, not one unmodified universal residual vector.

source_alignment.current_abi_role: deterministic basis/generation/role-bound q8 control packet; not itself hidden-state evidence

exact_runtime_source_observation.qwen3_source: src/models/qwen3.cpp at the pinned runtime source commit applies build_cvec(cur, il) in the Qwen3 layer loop and identifies the 28-layer/1024-embedding configuration as 0.6B

architecture_delta.proposed_chain: Global J-Space semantic/control coordinate -> JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 packet -> model/version/layer-specific LatentBasisAdapter -> native llama.cpp control-vector application -> exact model execution -> inference/J-Space causal receipt
adapter_must_bind: layer start/end or exact intervention stage mapping
architecture_delta.basis_law: A control vector is not transferable authority across model identities. The canonical command may be shared, but the residual coordinates require an explicitly calibrated model-specific projection/basis adapter.

negative_evidence: The exact-current Vercel PR810 deployment route was reachable only to Vercel deployment protection/SSO in this session; no function invocation/runtime logs were observed and no runtime credit was minted.
Raw cross-instance vectors were not robustly transferable.
Naive gradient direction did not dominate the calibrated mean-difference adapter.
No actual Qwen3-0.6B bytes were downloaded or executed in this local scratch experiment.
next_exact_gate: Implement and source-test JSPACE_LATENT_BASIS_ADAPTER/v1 around the already pinned llama.cpp native control-vector mechanism, then on an admitted zero-cost surface materialize the exact pinned Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 artifact and exact runtime build, bind actual loader consumption, calibrate layer-range/gain without evaluation leakage, and run BASELINE/+VECTOR/SIGN_FLIP/NULL/RANDOM-OR-PERMUTED controls with exact inference/J-Space receipts before granting any model-runtime or causal J-Space credit.
